_meta.description: Warlord subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: hybrid ATK/DEF, debuff control, off-tank survivability.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 0.5% et la DEF de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 0.5% and DEF by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des debuffs infliges de 1% et la precision de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 1% and accuracy by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les PV max de 1% et la reduction de degats de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max HP by 1% and damage reduction by 0.5% per level.
